ironmountain.name: Iron Mountain
ironmountain.shortDesc: Hyper Cutter + Suction Cups; entry or Mega Evolution clears own Stealth Rock/Spikes.
ironmountain.desc: Hyper Cutter + Suction Cups. Entry clears its side’s Stealth Rock and Spikes after hazards take effect. Mega Evolution also clears them; ability restarts do not.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.shortDesc: Intact disguise blocks one hit, then costs 1/8 HP and curses an opposing attacker.
disguise.desc: Intact Mimikyu and Totem Mimikyu block one damaging hit, become busted and lose 1/8 max HP. An opposing attacker is cursed for 1/8 max HP each turn. Confusion can break Disguise; Mold Breaker bypasses it. Transform does not grant protection.

stancechange.name: Stance Change
stancechange.shortDesc: Attacks enter Blade (+20% power); King’s Shield enters Shield (20% less damage).
stancechange.desc: Aegislash enters Blade before damaging moves and Shield before King’s Shield. Blade deals 20% more damage; Shield takes 20% less, plus a further 30% reduction after its first damaging hit each turn in Free-for-All. Fairy Tale and Chessboard stance stat changes apply. Transform and Gmax do not gain these stance changes.
